description: A button that sends a voltage for randomising the phase of the Luci cells patched to it

params.text: Held down, sends a voltage from the output that throws a Luci cell's phase to a random position

inputs.text: Nothing in the module reads this jack; the output is computed from the button alone, twice over, because the code adds the button to itself instead of adding the jack

outputs.text: Carries the randomise signal, 0V while the button is up and 2V while it is held

notes: the button is not a trigger: while it is held the cells patched to it are randomised on every sample
